name: R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems Limited
about: R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems Limited designs, manufactures, and sells micro irrigation equipment and components in India. It provides drip irrigation systems, such as online drip openable threaded drippers, flat drip smart line, online drip lateral, and pressure compensating drippers; sprinkler irrigation systems comprising mini and micro sprinklers; and HDPE pipes. The company also offers plastic disc filters, sand/gravel media filters, fertilizer injectors, fertigation tanks, and hydro-cyclone filters. In addition, it assists farmers in designing and installation of sprinkler and drip irrigations systems. The company serves irrigation companies and irrigation sub assembly manufacturers. R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Nashik, India.
